candidates.name: us-sales-tax-2026
candidates.what_it_holds: MIT-licensed dataset of US state sales tax rates plus lodging tax rates for 2026, all 50 states, packaged with a free API and an embeddable calculator widget. Rates only (statutory lodging/occupancy tax rate by state), not collections or occupancy volumes; single 2026 snapshot, not a time series.
candidates.why_useful: Could be a reference table for state-level lodging tax rate levels (Nevada/Florida/Texas/California/NY/Hawaii rates) but has no historical collections series or occupancy figures, so it doesn't fill the gap #8 need for actual occupancy/RevPAR/tax-collection time series.

notes: This theme returned essentially nothing usable via GitHub CLI repo search after 6 gh search calls (the hard per-scout limit): queries for 'hotel occupancy tax', 'transient occupancy tax', 'tourist development tax', 'lodging tax', 'STR occupancy', and 'occupancy rate hotel csv/dataset' surfaced almost exclusively (a) toy hotel-booking-system / tax-calculator apps (Sri Lanka VAT calculator, Louisiana hotel tax Python helper, Detroit Lakes Lodgify tax-return script, various 'HotelOccupancy' C++/Java class exercises), (b) Power BI / Kaggle-style hotel-booking-cancellation EDA notebooks with no government data, and (c) unrelated one-off repos (a Bexar County TX stadium-referendum precinct map that happens to mention hotel occupancy tax in its description, a St. Johns County FL short-term-rental portfolio's monthly DR-15 filing repo — private business filings, not public collections data). None had committed government hotel-tax-collection time series, occupancy-rate panels, or RevPAR data for NV/FL/TX/CA/NYC/HI. The one repo worth a line (receiptedit/us-sales-tax-2026) is a rates snapshot, not a collections/occupancy series. My two follow-up WebSearch queries (targeting Florida DR-15/county TDT collections mirrors and Texas Comptroller hotel-occupancy-tax scrapers on GitHub specifically) were blocked because the session's shared WebSearch budget (200/200) was already exhausted by other concurrent scouts before I could run mine — so this theme is under-searched relative to plan; a rerun of this theme via WebSearch (not gh) once budget resets, targeting 'site:github.com Florida DR-15 tourist development tax', 'site:github.com Texas comptroller hotel occupancy tax data', 'site:github.com Nevada gaming visitor statistics occupancy', 'site:github.com NYC hotel occupancy tax finance data', and 'site:github.com Hawaii TAT collections dataset' is likely to find real candidates (these agencies do publish CSV/Excel monthly collections and several are Socrata/CKAN-hosted, which tends to attract GitHub mirror/scraper repos) that gh's repo-search text index simply isn't surfacing because repo descriptions rarely use the exact statutory phrase. Recommend a second pass on this theme with WebSearch once budget allows.
